text: Her weapon is flattery mixed with pity. You foolish little woman. Your husband is a cunning lawyer who adores you. No man deserves to be adored as much as that. Don't let him fool you like this again. Notice that she never tells a plain lie about the affair; she simply tells a better story. The wife leaves happy, a perfect fool, kissing the actress goodbye.
